name: Sakuya
source:
Oukaya's hairdresser, who was bought and employed due to his impressive skills. While loved by the harlots, he's always cold towards them because he's not interested. He rarely smiles and never really changes his expression.

[Taken from [URL=http://otome-jikan.net/2013/11/19/yoshiwara-higanbana/]Otome Jikan's character profile translations[/URL].]
